dslRule:
<!id: junit.framework.Assert-to-org.junit.Assert>
<!description: Replaces usages of deprecated junit.framework.Assert with org.junit.Assert.>
<!severity: WARNING>
junit.framework.Assert.$method($args$)
=>
org.junit.Assert.$method($args$)
;;
